description.value:
This tiny metal disc is etched with intricate magicircuitry and tuned for remote viewing. You must sync your mind to the psychic frequencies of the telesthetic beacon to be able to receive information from it; this process takes 10 minutes and requires the beacon to be in your possession the entire time. You can be attuned to only one beacon at a time, but once you've done so, you remain attuned to that beacon until you attune to another beacon, another creature attunes themselves to that beacon, or the beacon is destroyed. You gain a +2 item bonus to your Stealth check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Conceal an Object]{Conceal} a telesthetic beacon on your person or in a location. You can also plant a telesthetic beacon on an unwilling creature using a @Check[thievery|against:perception] check; this works like @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Steal]{Stealing} an object from that creature, except that, on a success, the target doesn't notice that the beacon has been placed on their person.

Activate—Remote Viewing (concentrate, scrying) 1 minute

Frequency once per day

Requirements You're within 1 mile of the telesthetic beacon you're attuned to

Effect For 10 minutes, you can hear through the telesthetic beacon as if using your normal auditory senses. If the beacon was planted in a target's pocket or the folds of their clothes, that fabric doesn't impede any information you receive.
